sources.title: Hebei Daily on-site report: Boda Langfang No. 2 Phase 2 functional validation
sources.publisher: Hebei Daily; republished by Hebei Provincial Cyberspace Administration
sources.attribution: Hebei Daily reporters Zhou Congcong and Liu Ying; Hebei CAC republication
sources.summary: October 9 site reporting describes Phase 2 engineers performing pre-operation functional tests. Named project manager Zhang Yuanyuan states that civil structure, external walls and MEP installation are complete and the validation round remains. End-October testing/acceptance and year-end operation are forecasts. This is attributed reporting, not an official inspection.
sources.date_semantics: October 9 is the dated on-site observation and participant account; October 12 is publication. Exact completion, acceptance and operation days are not established.

firsthand_status_statement.speaker: Zhang Yuanyuan (张园园)
firsthand_status_statement.speaker_role: Project manager, Boda Langfang No. 2 Intelligent Computing Campus project
firsthand_status_statement.project_identity: 博大数据廊坊二号智算基地二期项目, explicitly Phase 2
firsthand_status_statement.statement: The named manager states that civil structure, exterior walls and internal MEP installation are finished and this validation round remains. The directly preceding on-site reporter observation records engineers performing functional validation tests.
firsthand_status_statement.date_semantics: The article dates the site visit to October 9. The manager account is attributed in that on-site passage; scheduled end-October acceptance and year-end operation are not achieved events.
firsthand_status_statement.review: Root and an independent research agent reviewed the captured GB18030 body and explicit project-manager attribution. The commissioning interpretation combines the manager account with the contemporaneous on-site test observation. The test sentence is reporter narrative, not misrepresented as a direct manager quote. Official republication supplies provenance only.

sources.title: Boda northern-campus directory and named Langfang No. 2 Baidu marker
sources.summary: The Langfang No. 2 named slide has data-zuo=116.661689,39.490269 and passes these values unchanged to Baidu BMap.Point. Campus marker only; BD-09 API context is established separately. The page does not publish a WGS84 point.
sources.date_semantics: Undated campus directory; retrieval is not a status observation.

sources.title: Baidu-authored MapWrapper 1.2 source: GPS=0, Baidu=4, longitude=x, latitude=y and official forward endpoint
sources.summary: Primary API implementation documents the exact legacy forward endpoint and CRS arguments used in this packet. It is not an official inverse service or accuracy guarantee.
sources.date_semantics: Technical reference or calculation response, not a project status observation.

sources.title: Qi, Yu and Duan: A High-Accuracy Decryption Method of Baidu Map Coordinates, Journal of Geomatics 2022, 47(5):102–104
sources.attribution: Qi Yujie, Yu Xiaomin and Duan Zhiqiang / Journal of Geomatics
sources.summary: Peer-reviewed primary method reference, DOI 10.14188/j.2095-6045.2020498. Equation (3) defines equivalent offset iterative approximation: next estimate = current estimate + target BD09 - official_forward(current estimate). Its tests of API preimage recovery are not ground-truth accuracy evidence for these operator campus markers.
sources.date_semantics: Technical reference or calculation response, not a project status observation.
